integrity: Verified using locally regenerated stable-pair faces, orbit flags, actual collapses and reversible attaching-word simplifications; finite tests are not substitutes for the all-m proof.
scientific_limitations: For all m>=8 the theorem determines pi1, integral homology and homotopy dimension; full homotopy models are established only for m=8 and 9. Other m and higher homotopy groups are not classified. Independent checking has not been performed.
title: Stable Kneser orbit spaces: subgroup fundamental groups and two Moore-type classifications
